review_scope: Primary read the complete first-pass report and independently read the full env.json, task.json, controls.json, generator, browser JavaScript, mechanic CSS, grader, task verifier and solver. The shared verifier helper had already been read in full.
decision: Keep all labels and no profile exceptions. Tile elevation changes which card transitions are legal, so 3D is functional rather than decorative. Exact-use cards change both position and the remaining hand, requiring route planning. Strokes immediately produce a settled static state, the hand visibly marks spent cards, and neither interface needs sustained time-dependent control. No prerequisite information-reveal interaction is implemented.

rationale_clarifications.exploration_interface: The UI describes the interaction, surfaces and stroke rules at a general level; it does not print every numerical transition constant. The No label concerns the absence of a required probe or reveal stage, not a claim that all implementation parameters are written on screen. Illegal-move feedback is routine feedback, not itself evidence of exploration.

additional_source_evidence.claim: The constructed route includes actual elevation-changing chips; the 3D label is not based only on isometric decoration.
Spent cards remain marked and each input immediately redraws the settled ball; the full drag surface adds no duration criterion.

uncertainties: Source review only; visual legibility, human calibration and screenshot-only agent success were not measured.
